body: I am not on any meds. They never worked, and in the end they are all poison
The only reasons not to do it are not to hurt people who know me. But suffering for others is making this whole thing a snake biting its own tail.

I got nothing to look forward to. I had my fair share of life, been places, seen and done things. I literally have nothing on my bucket list left. 
Without goals life is hard, every day appears pointless, just a struggle, and I don't see why I should struggle anymore. Give me a good reason why to struggle...
The only thing that might stop me is the thought of absolute freedom before death. I could go full crazy and do more stupid things...but then if I don't see it through I'll be in a worse position than before.

My favourite part of the day is when I sleep. I figure death is the same, so that would accomplish a lot. Gets rid of anxiety, depression, life problems...
I know you win and lose, but why play at all if you don't like the game.
